name: @aipowersalon/tenant-context
description: Trusted tenant context (Constitution 13 §72–74): the TenantContext / BranchContext / RequestContext shapes, the ONE derivation of a request's context from its verified session (contextFromSession), and the ONE factory for a worker or scheduler acting for a tenant with no user (systemContext). No app implements its own currentTenant logic; nothing here is a global mutable (§74). Foundation: dependency-free, framework-free.
